Use this reusable template to write and share your crochet cardigan patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for bottom-up one-piece cardigans with optional mosaic crochet, colorwork bands, and join-as-you-go cuffs and collar.

### Special Technique: Mosaic Crochet

**Chart reading:**
- Right-side (RS) rows: Read chart from right to left
- Wrong-side (WS) rows: Read chart from left to right
- Each chart row corresponds to 2 crochet rows: Row [N] (RS) and Row [N]a (WS)

**Color changes:**
- Work 2 rows in each color (RS + WS)
- Change color on the last yarn over of the last stitch of Row [N]a
- Carry yarn up the right side of the work: crochet over the carried color in the first and last stitch of each row

**Mosaic stitch rules:**
- Box with row color: Work 1 sc in the corresponding row color
- Box with contrasting color: Ch 1, skip 1 st (do not change color)
- Box marked X: Work 1 drop-down dc into the skipped st 3 rows below (RS) / Work 1 sc (WS)

### Charts

**Chart Key**

| Symbol | Stitch |
|---|---|
| [ ] | SC in row color |
| [ ] | Ch 1, sk 1 st |
| [X] | Drop-down dc 3 rows below (RS) / SC (WS) |

**Stitch Pattern Chart:** Chain a multiple of [N] plus [N]. Worked [N] times across.

RS rows: Read right to left. WS rows: Read left to right.

## Pattern Instructions

### Band

With [hook size] and MC, ch [N].

```plaintext
SC in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, turn — [N] sts.
Row 2: Ch 1, SC in BLO of each st across, turn — [N] sts.
Repeat Row 2 until band measures [N] in / cm.
```

### Body

With [larger hook] and MC or A, ch 1, sc evenly along the length of the band (1 sc per row).

**Work from chart:** Work Rows 1-[N] of Stitch Pattern Chart.

**Written instructions (no chart):**

```plaintext
[Row-by-row instructions with color changes]
[Continue until piece measures N in / cm from pick-up edge]
```

**Sizing adjustment:** Work fewer rows for larger sizes so that all sizes reach the same length.

### Separate Fronts and Back

**Right Front:**

```plaintext
[Work across first N sts for right front. Leave remaining sts unworked.]
[Work even in pattern for N rows.]
```

Fasten off.

**Back:**

With a slip knot on the hook, join into the first skipped st.

```plaintext
[Work across next N sts for back.]
[Work even in pattern for N rows.]
```

Fasten off.

**Left Front:**

With a slip knot on the hook, join into the first skipped st.

```plaintext
[Work across remaining N sts for left front.]
[Work even in pattern for N rows.]
```

Fasten off.

### Shoulder Seaming

With right sides facing, fold in the front panels. Use a yarn needle to whip stitch or seam the shoulders using your preferred method.

### Sleeves

Repeat for left and right sleeve. Worked in the round from the armhole opening.

With [hook size] and CC, join into the center of the underarm space.

```plaintext
Rnd 1: Ch 2, evenly space [N] hdc around the arm opening. Join with rev sl st, turn — [N] sts.
Rnd 2: Ch 2, hdc in each st around. Join with rev sl st, turn.
[Decrease rnd: Ch 2, hdc in first st, hdc2tog, hdc to last 3 sts, hdc2tog, hdc in last st. Join with rev sl st, turn.]
Work decrease round every [N] rounds until [N] sts remain.
Work even until sleeve measures [N] in / cm.
```

On the last round, change to MC to prepare for cuff.

**Cuff (join-as-you-go):**

With [hook size] and MC, work cuff directly onto the last round of the sleeve.

```plaintext
Row 1: Ch [N], sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, skip first st at edge, sl st in next 2 sts, turn — [N] sts.
Row 2: Skip sl sts, sc in BLO of each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in BLO of each st across, sl st in next 2 sts at edge, turn.
Repeat Rows 2 and 3 for each st around the cuff edge.
With RS facing, sl st the cuff ends together. Fasten off and weave in tails.
```

### Edging

With [hook size], join MC to the right front panel edge with a sl st.

```plaintext
Row 1 (RS): Ch 1, work sl sts evenly along the right front edge, across the neck opening, and down the left front edge.
Row 2: With [edging hook size], join MC. Ch 1, work 1 sc in the BLO of each st along the right front, neck, and left front edge.
```

### Collar (join-as-you-go)

With [hook size], join MC to the right front panel edge.

```plaintext
Row 1: Ch [N], sc in 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across, skip first st at edge, sl st in next 2 sts, turn — [N] sts.
Row 2: Skip sl sts, sc in BLO of each st across, turn.
Row 3: Ch 1, sc in BLO of each st across, sl st in next 2 sts at edge, turn.
Repeat Rows 2 and 3 for the entire edge of the cardigan.
Fasten off and weave in tails.
```

Lightly steam the collar edge to prevent curling.
